posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
Welcome to the community, Albavar!

Unfortunately, Adobe doesn’t allow images in dropdowns for Acrobat files. It’s possible to do it with some JavaScripting and other customizations, but no one has had the combination of skills and time to do that, to date.

I usually insert the icon I want manually, which isn’t as convenient but it looks pretty good. The icons are available in a few places, but I have them up here: http://www.luzetski.net/SCRPG/SCRPG_icons.zip. (Link fixed for now. )
posts.raw:

Unfortunately, Adobe doesn't allow images in dropdowns for Acrobat files. :cry: It's possible to do it with some JavaScripting and other customizations, but no one has had the combination of skills and time to do that, to date.
